question: how to raise the zero-click preview success rate from its current measured value toward 95%+ (UX scoring matrix critical gate: cap 84 -> 100)?
summary: OSD nomination completed 2026-11-03: 4 candidates (A: representative-sheet coverage + defect inventory; B: print-defect root-cause remediation; C: default-state tuning; D: gate instrumentation / evidence artifact). A ADOPTED for Phase 1 — the only cluster satisfying R1 (moves the rate), R2 (reproducible) and R3 (resolves the 94% vs 0.886 measurement gap) together, and the only one with zero product surface. B NOT ADMITTED for Phase 1 (deferred): the only direct R1 mover but cannot satisfy R2/R3 alone — it is the expected Phase-2 body once A produces the defect inventory. C NOT ADMITTED for Phase 1 (deferred and demoted): satisfies R1 only conditionally, fails R2/R3, and nothing on this tree can currently distinguish a default-driven failure from a sheet-specific one. D NOT ADMITTED as a standalone cluster (subsumed): satisfies R2/R3 and fails R1 by construction, so it is A's deliverable rather than A's alternative.
decision_summary: ADOPTED: Candidate A (representative-sheet coverage and defect inventory) for Phase 1. NOT ADMITTED for Phase 1: B (deferred, expected Phase 2), C (deferred and demoted), D (subsumed into A). Every rejection carries its recall condition in counterfactual_ledger.md.

rating.scheme: admissibility filter (R1-R5) applied BEFORE utility ranking, per subspace-deliberation R1
rating.ranking_note: A > B > D > C by leverage per unit of unverified premise. D ranks above C despite failing R1 because D's failure is structural (it never claims to move the rate) while C's is evidential (it may move the rate with no way to show it).

premise_corrections: The narrative 94% is not reproduced by any artifact on disk; temp/ux_matrix/evidence_current.json carries 0.886 and its own note says that value is an SC-A2 proxy, not a matrix-valid representative-sheet measurement (score_run_20261029.json disposition P3).

The spec's ceiling-lift claim is conditional: with the current evidence raw_score + severity = 77.92, which is BELOW the 84 cap, so the cap is not binding today and raising it does not by itself raise this evidence's final score.
The cap contract itself IS verified by run.py: 94% and 88.6% both cap at 84; 95% caps at 100.
